stem:
Preeti has an iron nail and a bar magnet that look alike when painted. One bar is labelled N. She also has a known magnet.

How can she tell which of the painted objects is a magnet?

options.text: By seeing which end is labelled N.
By seeing which one can repel the other; repulsion identifies a magnet.
By seeing attraction only; both can attract, so that test is enough.
By seeing which one is attracted by a known magnet; attraction proves it is a magnet.

teacher.key_rationale: Attraction can happen with iron. Only repulsion identifies a magnet.
